page.notes: The scan is clear enough for a full transcription. Doubtful: "guberuatur" (printed as shown, possibly a misprint for "gubernatur"), marked in the text as printed. The printed "Quarto ( ait )" is given with "(ait)" in italics. The printed "fenfu" is transcribed as "sensu" under the long-s rule, and "eft" as "est". The catchword "dicā-" at the foot is partly cut off and may read differently. The stray marks at the right edge and the dots at the lower right are not printed text and were left out.
